*Published September 14, 2026 by the Tsenta Team*


International[students on OPT](https://tsenta.com/blog/how-to-apply-100-h1b-sponsor-companies-before-opt-expires) have time-limited work authorization and may need to track unemployment-day rules with their DSO. This guide compares the AI job application tools most relevant to F-1 and STEM OPT candidates in 2026, ranked by how well they help candidates reach qualified roles through real employer systems.[Tsenta](https://tsenta.com/) leads the list because the product was built for exactly this problem: an AI agent that surfaces relevant roles, prepares job-specific résumés and[cover letters](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-auto-apply-tools-tailored-resume-cover-letter-2026) , and submits complete applications on supported employer systems, with an inspectable receipt for every successful submission.


## Why AI Job Application Tools Matter During OPT


Standard post-completion OPT can provide up to 12 months of work authorization, and eligible students may receive a 24-month STEM extension. Individual dates and unemployment limits vary, so candidates should confirm their situation with their DSO. Application tools can reduce repetitive work while candidates focus on qualified roles and current employer sponsorship signals.


### The Specific Problems OPT Job Seekers Face


- Sponsorship filtering: job boards do not always show current employer sponsorship policies, so candidates should treat platform signals as a starting point and verify important details.
- Time pressure: the OPT clock does not pause, and[unemployment days on OPT](https://studyinthestates.dhs.gov/stem-opt-hub/additional-resources/stem-opt-extension-overview) are capped at 90 days on standard OPT and 150 days total with the STEM extension.
- ATS complexity: real jobs live on Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, and similar systems, and each has its own multi-step forms and work-authorization questions.
- Answer accuracy: work-auth and sponsorship questions should use the candidate's saved information and be reviewed when needed.


AI tools solve these problems by pre-filtering roles, tailoring materials to the job description, and either autofilling or fully submitting applications on your behalf. Tsenta specifically targets the submission and receipt problem: it applies end-to-end on supported employer systems and keeps a receipt of what was sent, so candidates can inspect what was submitted.


## What to Look For in an AI Job Application Tool for OPT


OPT candidates should evaluate tools against a stricter checklist than the general market. Speed and volume matter, but so do sponsorship signals, ATS coverage, and control over how work-authorization answers get filled in. Tsenta was built to check every box here, with review controls available, cover letters prepared when supported or required, and a public baseline of[19 supported employer systems](https://tsenta.com/ai-disclosure) including Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and others.


### Features That Actually Matter for OPT


- Sponsorship signals on roles you see in your match feed.
- Profile-based handling of work-authorization questions on supported application workflows.
- Coverage of the employer systems where real jobs live, not just LinkedIn Easy Apply.
- Tailored résumés and cover letters per role, based on your saved candidate context.
- A receipt for every successful submission, so you can audit what went out.
- Transparent, published pricing with no forced overage charges.


When Tsenta evaluates competitors on this list, we weigh these features against what OPT candidates actually need. A tool focused on job-board applications may not cover the employer systems used by a candidate's target companies. Candidates should compare support for Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and other systems against their own employer list.


## How OPT Candidates Are Using AI Tools to Land Sponsorship


OPT candidates can run layered searches. They can combine a matched role feed with a submission engine, review the output, and treat each application as data. Below are common strategies and where Tsenta fits into each.


**Strategy 1: Pre-filter for sponsorship before applying.** OPT candidates use employer sponsorship signals and public H-1B LCA history to narrow the target list. Tsenta surfaces relevant roles in your match feed so you spend allowance on roles that fit.


**Strategy 2: Apply as qualified roles surface.** Candidates can use Tsenta to prepare and submit applications running through supported employer systems including Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and others.


**Strategy 3: Tailor materials per role, not per company.** Tsenta prepares job-specific résumés and cover letters from your saved candidate context. Cover letters are prepared when supported or required by the employer system.


**Strategy 4: Keep a receipt trail.** Every successful Tsenta submission generates an inspectable receipt, which matters when you are running hundreds of applications a month and need to prove which roles you actually reached.


**Strategy 5: Use mobile for the hours you are not at a desk.** Tsenta is live on iOS and Android, so OPT candidates can review and confirm applications between classes, interviews, or shifts.


**Strategy 6: Protect the allowance.** Only successful submissions consume Tsenta allowance. Skipped or failed applications are refunded, which means the tier you buy is the tier you get.


Taken together, these strategies are the reason Tsenta ranks first for OPT job seekers. Most tools solve one piece: autofill, matching, or a tracker. Tsenta prepares and submits the whole application, keeps the receipt, and stays honest about what it does not control.

### 2. Jobright AI


Jobright is a strong AI matching platform with a dedicated sponsorship filter, and its matching engine scores candidates against aggregated listings, and its Insider Connections feature surfaces alumni and employees at target companies you can ask for referrals. Most job search platforms do not filter for H1B-friendly employers, forcing visa holders to waste applications on companies that will not sponsor. Jobright's dedicated filter narrows the search to employers with a history of sponsoring work visas.


**Key Features:** AI job matching with match scores, Orion AI copilot, résumé tailoring, Chrome autofill, and an H1B sponsorship filter.


**OPT-Specific Offerings:** H1B filter and insider connections for referral-based outreach.


**Pricing:** A free plan is available. Check the current signup flow for paid pricing.


**Pros:** Real free tier, strong matching quality, useful sponsorship filter for OPT.


**Cons:** The AI Agent is assisted applying, not autopilot. On many jobs it sends you to the company site to finish by hand. Job coverage is United States only, which is fine for OPT but not for global fallback searches.


### 3. Simplify


Simplify is a widely used autofill tool in the category. Its "Copilot" Chrome extension fills out application forms on Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and other ATS in one click, auto-saves each application to a built-in tracker, and layers on an AI job board with daily matches, all on a genuinely free, uncapped tier. For OPT candidates, Simplify is a decent starting point because it also flags sponsorship on job cards.


**Key Features:** Chrome autofill across 100-plus ATS, tracker, job matching, résumé and cover letter tools on the paid tier.


**OPT-Specific Offerings:** Sponsorship checkbox on job cards.


**Pricing:** Free core tier; paid options are available.


**Pros:** Generous free tier, wide ATS coverage, easy to install.


**Cons:** It focuses on autofill, so final submission may still require user action.


### 4. LazyApply


LazyApply is a volume-first Chrome extension. Its entry plan starts at $99 per year. Once you set up your profile and default answers, it can rapidly submit applications on LinkedIn (Easy Apply), Indeed, and ZipRecruiter.


**Key Features:** High-volume auto-apply on a small set of job boards, résumé builder, application tracker.


**OPT-Specific Offerings:** None specific to sponsorship.


**Pricing:** Starts at $99 per year.


**Pros:** Cheap on a per-application basis if you use the daily cap, simple flat pricing.


**Cons:** Auto-applies to jobs across LinkedIn, Indeed, and ZipRecruiter, so candidates should compare its coverage with the systems used by their target companies. No sponsorship filter, and volume without targeting is not the OPT strategy.


### 5. AIApply


AIApply is a broader AI-powered application suite. AIApply is an AI-powered platform that automates job applications, enhancing your chances by optimizing résumés and cover letters. The platform is integrated with top job portals, including Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Dice, SimplyHired, and more. It also offers mock interviews and a résumé builder.


**Key Features:** Auto-apply, AI résumé builder, cover letter generator, mock interviews.


**OPT-Specific Offerings:** None specific to sponsorship.


**Pricing:** Monthly subscription with add-on modules for résumé and cover letter functionality.


**Pros:** Broad feature set, includes interview prep.


**Cons:** Add-on pricing can escalate quickly. No dedicated sponsorship filter for OPT candidates.


### 6. LoopCV


LoopCV is a cloud-based auto-apply platform focused on relevance. LoopCV auto-applies to 100+ matched jobs a week across LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor and 30+ more. It positions itself against LazyApply-style volume by matching first and applying more selectively.


**Key Features:** Cloud auto-apply, job matching, recruiter outreach, résumé tailoring.


**OPT-Specific Offerings:** None specific to sponsorship.


**Pricing:** Free plan and monthly subscriptions.


**Pros:** Match-based apply cadence, useful for candidates who want the tool to run in the background.


**Cons:** Coverage is weighted toward job boards rather than every employer system, so candidates should compare it with their target-company list.


### 7. Migrate Mate


Migrate Mate is a job search platform built specifically for international candidates. Migrate Mate is a job search platform built for international professionals, immigrants, and international students looking for work in the U.S. that offers visa sponsorship. Migrate Mate filters separate OPT/CPT acceptance from H-1B sponsorship willingness, so you can search for employers who will take you now on OPT and sponsor your H-1B later as two distinct criteria.


**Key Features:** Verified sponsorship data, curated employer list, OPT vs H-1B filter split.


**OPT-Specific Offerings:** The core product is OPT and H-1B filtering.


**Pricing:** Subscription-based; see the current site for exact tiers.


**Pros:** Strong sponsorship data, purpose-built for international candidates.


**Cons:** Not an application submission engine, so you still need a tool like Tsenta to actually apply at volume once you have your target list.


### 8. Scale.jobs


Scale.jobs uses trained human assistants instead of automation. Scale.jobs uses trained human assistants to manually craft and submit tailored applications, focusing on quality over quantity. Pricing starts at $199 for 250 applications.


**Key Features:** Human-submitted applications, tailored per role.


**OPT-Specific Offerings:** Human review of work-authorization answers.


**Pricing:** Check the current site for package pricing.


**Pros:** Human review is a feature for candidates who want extra oversight on sensitive questions.


**Cons:** Slower and more expensive per application than an AI agent. Not ideal when speed matters and the OPT clock is running.


## Evaluation Framework for AI Job Application Tools for OPT


OPT candidates should weigh categories differently than the general market. The framework below is how Tsenta ranks tools for this specific use case.


- Sponsorship signal quality: 25%
- Employer system coverage (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, and others): 25%
- End-to-end submission vs autofill: 20%
- Pricing transparency and refund on failed submissions: 15%

A tool that scores high on volume but low on sponsorship signals is a poor fit for an OPT candidate. A tool that scores high on sponsorship data but low on submission coverage still leaves you filling out Workday forms by hand. Tsenta is designed to score high across all six categories.
